Bienvenue. À La Fuga, le but du jeu est: Welcome. In La Fuga, the goal is to bring your Heir (the framed piece) to its rally zone at the far end of the board. Of course, you must also stop your opponent from doing the same. The Heir can get there on its own or by being pushed.
Clique sur l'Héritier pour le sélectionn: Tap the Heir to select it.
Toutes les pièces peuvent se déplacer d': Every piece can move one square in any direction. Move the Heir to an adjacent square.
Pour valider ton coup, clique à nouveau: To confirm your move, tap the piece again on its new square.
Pour se déplacer, une pièce RONDE doit t: To move, a ROUND piece must touch another round piece (friendly or enemy), and a SQUARE piece must touch another square piece. In green: the pieces that can move. In red: the blocked pieces (no piece of their shape beside them).
Une pièce ronde saute par-dessus une aut: A round piece jumps over another round piece (friendly or enemy), in a STRAIGHT line or DIAGONALLY, and can chain jumps! Tap the Nurse.
Clique à nouveau sur la Nurse pour valid: Tap the Nurse again to confirm your multi-jump.
Bravo ! Sauts droits et diagonaux : tu m: Well done! Straight and diagonal jumps: you've mastered the multi-jump.
L'Héritier peut lui aussi enchaîner les: The Heir can also chain jumps, straight or diagonal, and even FLEE by jumping. Tap the Heir.
Fugue réussie ! L'Héritier a atteint son: Successful escape! The Heir reached its rally zone: VICTORY!
Saut en DIAGONALE par-dessus ré2, jusqu': DIAGONAL jump over ré2, to mi3.
Saut tout DROIT par-dessus fa3, jusqu'en: STRAIGHT jump over fa3, to sol3.
De nouveau en DIAGONALE par-dessus fa4,: Again DIAGONALLY over fa4, to mi5.
Et tout DROIT par-dessus mi6, jusqu'en m: And STRAIGHT over mi6, to mi7.
Saut en DIAGONALE par-dessus fa4, jusqu': DIAGONAL jump over fa4, to sol5.
Saut tout DROIT par-dessus sol6, jusqu'e: STRAIGHT jump over sol6, to sol7.
Dernier saut, en DIAGONALE par-dessus fa: Last jump, DIAGONALLY over fa8: the Heir LEAVES the board and reaches its rally zone!
Les pièces carrées d'un même camp qui se: Square pieces of the same side that touch, even diagonally, form a UNIT. Several pieces of the same unit can move together, in the same direction. Let's move several pieces of the green unit; tap do2, which will be the leader.
Ajoute ré2 puis fa3 à la sélection (on l: Add ré2 then fa3 to the selection (we leave mi2 out: you don't have to take them all).
L'unité se déplace selon la meneuse. Cli: The unit moves according to the leader. Tap do3 to move the chosen pieces up one square.
Clique sur la meneuse pour valider ton c: Tap the leader to confirm your move.
En montant, la pièce en fa s'est retrouv: By moving up, the piece on fa ended up alone (framed)! A maneuver can thus IMMOBILIZE a piece: fa no longer has any square piece beside it.
Le GARDE (croix ×) se déplace en diagona: The GUARD (× cross) moves diagonally and PUSHES in a straight line. Tap the Guard.
Déplace le Garde en diagonale, jusqu'en: Move the Guard diagonally, to fa4.
Maintenant POUSSE : clique en sol4. Tout: Now PUSH: tap sol4. The whole line is pushed back one square, and the piece at the edge falls off the board (eliminated)!
Clique sur le Garde pour valider ton cou: Tap the Guard to confirm your move.
Bravo ! Le Garde a poussé la ligne et él: Well done! The Guard pushed the line and eliminated a piece. This is the ONLY way to eliminate a piece: push it off the board. And you can even eliminate your OWN pieces!
Le SOLDAT (croix +) se déplace en ligne: The SOLDIER (+ cross) moves in a straight line and PUSHES diagonally. Tap the Soldier.
Move the Soldier straight, to do4.
POUSSE en diagonale : clique en ré5 pour: PUSH diagonally: tap ré5 to push the piece back.
Clique sur le Soldat pour valider ton co: Tap the Soldier to confirm your move.
Attention : en se déplaçant, le Soldat s: Careful: by moving, the Soldier moved away from its ally and no longer has a square piece beside it; it is now BLOCKED (framed) until a square piece joins it.
Après s'être déplacée, une carrée peut p: After moving, a square piece can push in SEVERAL directions, as many as you like. Tap the Guard.
Move the Guard diagonally, to fa4.
Bravo ! Tu as poussé en haut et à droite: Well done! You pushed up and to the right. Note: fa3 (below) could also have been pushed, but we left it — you choose which directions to push.
Pousse une 1re direction : clique en fa5: Push a first direction: tap fa5 (upward).
Tu peux pousser une AUTRE direction ! Cl: You can push in ANOTHER direction! Tap sol4 (to the right).
On peut aussi POUSSER son propre Héritie: You can also PUSH your own Heir! Tap the Guard.
Déplace le Garde en diagonale, en fa7 (s: Move the Guard diagonally, to fa7 (below the Heir).
POUSSE vers le haut : clique en fa8. L'H: PUSH upward: tap fa8. The Heir is pushed into its rally zone!
Fugue ! Tu as poussé ton Héritier dans s: Escape! You pushed your Heir into its rally zone: VICTORY!
Enfin, pousser l'Héritier ADVERSE hors d: Finally, pushing the OPPONENT's Heir off the board checkmates it. Tap the Guard.
Déplace le Garde en diagonale, en la7 (s: Move the Guard diagonally, to la7 (below the enemy Heir).
POUSSE vers le haut : clique en la8. L'H: PUSH upward: tap la8. The enemy Heir is ejected from the board!
Mat ! Tu as poussé l'Héritier adverse ho: Checkmate! You pushed the enemy Heir off the board: VICTORY!
Le CHEVALIER (l'hexagone) est une pièce: The KNIGHT (the hexagon) is a special piece with two powers. UNSHAKABLE: it can never be pushed; a push stops dead against it. INDEPENDENT: it can move even if it touches no piece of its shape (it needs no neighbor to move).
Puisqu'il ne peut être poussé, le Cheval: Since it can't be pushed, the Knight acts as a WALL: it blocks pushes. Here, even if the enemy Guard advances to fa3 to push upward, the Knight (fa4) stops everything: the Heir (fa5) is protected.
Voici toutes les façons dont une partie: Here are all the ways a game can end, and how many points each one is worth.
FUGUE (+2 points). Ton Héritier atteint: ESCAPE (+2 points). Your Heir reaches its rally zone (the arrow): you win the game! It's the most valued victory. A Nurse in contact lets it move.
DOUBLE FUGUE (0 point). Quand les Blancs: DOUBLE ESCAPE (0 points). When White escapes, Black gets a LAST move to equalize. If both Heirs reach their rally zone, the game is drawn. Here it's White to move, and both Heirs can escape (arrows).
MAT (+1 point). Le Garde (si6) se déplac: MATE (+1 point). The Guard (si6) moves to la7, then pushes the enemy Heir (la8) off the board: it is ejected, you win.
GUILLOTINE. L'adversaire va fuguer (son: GUILLOTINE. The opponent is about to escape (their Heir fa1, mobile thanks to its Nurse, reaches its rally zone at the bottom: +2 for them). To limit the damage, your Guard (si6 to la7) pushes YOUR OWN Heir (la8) off the board: it's a self-mate, the opponent gets only +1 instead of +2.
PAPATTE (+1 point). C'est à l'adversaire: PAPATTE (+1 point). It's the opponent's turn, but they have NO legal move: their Knight (do8) is stuck, and their Heir (si8) is isolated (no round piece beside it). They lose. Very rare!
TRÊVE (0 point). Quand plus AUCUN joueur: TRUCE (0 points). When NEITHER player has a square piece that can move (no matter whose turn it is), the game is drawn: with no mobile square piece, no push is possible. Here, both square pieces (framed) are isolated.
NULLE PAR ACCORD (0 point). Pendant une: DRAW BY AGREEMENT (0 points). During a game, you can offer a draw with the “½” button (circled); if the opponent accepts, the game is drawn. REPETITION: if the same position occurs 4 times, the draw is automatic.
ABANDON / TEMPS / DÉCONNEXION (+2 points: RESIGN / TIME / DISCONNECT (+2 points each). Three ways to win without playing: if the opponent RESIGNS (the “X” button), if their TIME reaches 0:00 (the clock), or if they DISCONNECT. In all three cases, you win +2 points.

Avant une partie, choisis un OBJECTIF (P: Before a game, choose an OBJECTIVE (Game = a single one; 3/5/7 = first to that many points) and a TIME control (minutes per player). In 3/5/7, if the opponent reaches the score while you've played one fewer game as White, you play a FINAL game as White to even out the colors.
Puis lance : « Jouer en local » (à deux: Then start: “Play locally” (two players on the same device) or “Play online”. Online, matchmaking finds you an opponent of your level; it's the ONLY mode that changes your MÉLO, your rating (~1500 at the start), which goes up when you win and down when you lose.
« deep grey » est l'intelligence artific: “Deep Grey” is the game's artificial intelligence: play against it to train whenever you like.
Cherche un joueur par son nom pour le dé: Search for a player by name to challenge them directly; the star manages your favorites.
Fais glisser l'écran vers le BAS pour la: Swipe the screen DOWN for CORRESPONDENCE: games with no time limit, against registered players. To start one, tap an empty board, then choose your opponent from your favorites.
« Compte » : crée ton compte ici. Il est: “Account”: create your account here. It is REQUIRED to play online and by correspondence.
« Random » active la variante Random Fug: “Random” enables the Random Fuga variant: the starting position is drawn at random from 1750 positions × 2 types of symmetry, i.e. 3500 possible openings. It resets on every launch.
« Plus » donne accès à ce tuto, à l'hist: “More” gives access to this tutorial, your game history, analysis, settings, and to SUPPORTING THE DEVELOPERS (a small donation to help the game).
Et voilà, tu sais tout ! Le reste (thème: That's it, you know everything! The rest (themes, settings, history, analysis) you'll discover on your own. Happy escaping!
